profile.headline: Software Engineer | Insurance Specialist | Content Creator
profile.summary:
I’m a visionary who dreams in code and finds fulfillment in the results. Growing up I always broke random things and learned how to fix the problems I made for myself. As I started growing into my career, I found that my enjoyment comes from supporting others and finding solutions to their problems/code. I take pride in learning from teaching. I’m a problem solver. I thrive off building opportunities for business needs. I like building from scratch and am result-driven. I look forward to creating my brand and awareness for the love of code. 

My skills are in building curricula and programs for those who want to make a change in the world through tech.

positions.title: Digital production specialist (Contract - University of Chicago)
Web Developer
positions.description: Currently, I serve as a Front-End Web Developer for this start up company. Here, I participate in website implementation and site maintenance. I have also helped optimize the data management for the current project for Ricoh imaging by 50%. This optimization has translated to a faster page load time by 5%. In my current role, I am always learning and expanding my programming abilities both server and client side.

positions.title: Double Agent Covert
positions.description: As a Double Agent with Geek Squad I worked directly with clients in their homes and businesses. Many of my clients, when taking the evaluation survey for their visit mentioned my suburb interpersonal (soft) skills. All of my clients enjoyed that I understood the products or problems I encountered, but did not explain the solution over their heads. I also contributed to the highest performing team in the company, with 93% net promoter scores. I departed from the team to join a start-up company with two of my friends from high school.

positions.title: Communications Technician
positions.description: As a Comcast Technician I serviced the suburban Chicagoland area. During my time here I engaged customers in such a way that reflected in my Personal Customer Satisfaction rating. I was consistently rated in the 90 percentile while seeing 16-20 customers per week. I also helped maintain the Upstream signal for the area, keeping it above 70%. Because of financial and physical reasons, this opportunity was a short stint.

honors.title: National Security Agency Scholarship
honors.description:
I completed 4 security exercises during the scholarship program.
-Host Enumeration
-Active and Passive Reconnaissance
-Poison Ivy - Remote Access Trojan (RAT)
-SQL Injection

I also presented an essay detailing:
-the new cyber security challenges facing the United States 
-What can be done to help fill the projected gap in the cyber security workforce during this time
-What can I do to help advance cyber security in the United States or in your community, school, or workplace
honors.issuer: Issued by Southern Illinois Collegiate Cyber Co-Op · Jan 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: An annual back to school rally for the North Lawndale community in which I had the pleasure of serving. We supplied the community hundreds of bags filled with school supplies (ages preK through High School).
